sentences.en: Next on the agenda we have traffic and highways.
sentences.zh: 接下来议程上是交通与高速公路议题。

sentences.en: Well, we now have the results of the survey carried out last month about traffic and road transport in the town.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们现已获得上个月开展的关于本镇交通与道路运输状况调查的结果。

sentences.en: People were generally satisfied with the state of the roads.
sentences.zh: 民众总体上对道路状况表示满意。

sentences.en: There were one or two complaints about potholes which will be addressed, but a significant number of people complained about the increasing number of heavy vehicles using our local roads to avoid traffic elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 有零星一两起关于路面坑洼的投诉，我们将予以处理；但有相当数量的民众投诉称，越来越多的重型车辆为避开其他路段的拥堵而驶入我们的本地道路。

sentences.en: We'd expected more complaints by commuters about the reduction in the train service, but it doesn't seem to have affected people too much.
sentences.zh: 我们原本预计通勤族会对列车班次减少提出更多投诉，但实际情况似乎并未对民众造成太大影响。

sentences.en: The cycle path that runs alongside the river is very well used by both cyclists and pedestrians since the surface was improved last year, but overtaking can be a problem so we're going to add a bit on the side to make it wider.
sentences.zh: 沿河修建的自行车道自去年改善路面后，深受骑行者和步行者欢迎，但超车问题较为突出，因此我们计划在道路一侧加宽部分区域。

sentences.en: At some stage, we'd like to extend the path so that it goes all the way through the town, but that won't be happening in the immediate future.
sentences.zh: 未来某个阶段，我们希望将该步道延伸至贯穿全城，但短期内尚无法实现。

sentences.en: The plans to have a pedestrian crossing next to the Post Office have unfortunately had to be put on hold for the time being.
sentences.zh: 在邮局旁设置人行横道的计划，很遗憾目前不得不暂时搁置。

sentences.en: We'd budgeted for this to be done this financial year, but then there were rumours that the Post Office was going to move, which would have meant there wasn't really a need for a crossing.
sentences.zh: 我们原计划在本财年内完成此项工程，但当时传出邮局可能搬迁的消息，若属实，则人行横道便无实际必要。

sentences.en: Now they've confirmed that they're staying where they are, but the Highways Department have told us that it would be dangerous to have a pedestrian crossing where we'd originally planned it as there's a bend in the road there.
sentences.zh: 如今邮局已确认将继续留在原址，但公路部门告知我们，按原定位置设置人行横道存在安全隐患，因为该处道路存在弯道。

sentences.en: So that'll need some more thought.
sentences.zh: 因此，此事还需进一步研究。

sentences.en: On Station Road near the station and level crossing, drivers can face quite long waits if the level crossing^ closed, and we've now got signs up requesting them not to leave their engines running at that time.
sentences.zh: 在车站路靠近火车站及平交道口处，若平交道口关闭，驾驶员可能面临较长等待时间；目前我们已在该处设立告示牌，提醒驾驶员此时切勿让发动机持续运转。

sentences.en: This means pedestrians waiting on the pavement to cross CHAIRPERSON： COUNCILLOR THORNTON：
sentences.zh: 这意味着行人需在人行道上等候过街。
